description:
# Interested in learning how to ride? We’re happy to show you the basics of natural horsemanship and basic riding skill.

##Duration 
1 hour 

##About
Designed for beginner to intermediate riders, these lessons focus on building confidence and connection with horses through natural horsemanship. Each session includes both groundwork and riding, covering skills like approaching, catching, saddling, and effective communication with your horse. Lessons are tailored to the individual, ensuring a personalized experience based on your comfort level and prior horse or riding experience. No two lessons are exactly the same, allowing you to progress at your own pace.
